source_title: Mike Myers Teases Austin Powers 4 Will Focus More on Dr. Evil: ‘From His Point of View’ - People.com
source_excerpt:
The villainous Dr. Evil is “a very fun character to do,” said the comedian
Mike Myers appeared on Hollywood Insiders with Hawk Koch and addressed his upcoming Austin Powers sequel
Austin Powers 4 is “more from Dr. Evil’s point of view, so far,” said the writer-actor
In the three installments of the hit comedy franchise, Myers has played the titular spy, villainous Dr. Evil and more
Mike Myers is dropping hints about the upcoming Austin Powers sequel .
“There is going to be more Dr. Evil,” Myers, 63, said in a clip from the podcast Hollywood Insiders with Hawk Koch shared on Instagram. This past June, the actor-writer confirmed that an Austin Powers 4 is in the works.
Asked if the new movie will be told from the point of view of Austin’s nemesis Dr. Evil, Myers recalled “the funniest thing” about the iconic villain. “It’s almost 50/50, people like Dr. Evil as much as they like Austin Powers. And one of the craziest things is one of the first studio notes, after a screening, was, ‘Less Dr. Evil. People don’t like him because he’s mean to Austin.’”
Myers remembered disagreeing and thinking the character “got laughs,” adding, “I don’t think it’s one of those movies where it’s ‘bad guys good guys.’ So that was one I had to navigate through.”
The fourth Austin Powers , he told filmmaker Hawk Koch, is “more from Dr. Evil’s point of view, so far. It’s a very fun character to do.”
Myers portrayed both his iconic British character Austin Powers and the bald and greedy Dr. Evil in three movies produced between 1997 and 2002, all spoofs of the 1960s spy genre. The previous entry, 2002’s Austin Powers in Goldmember , was a star-studded one, featuring Beyoncé , Michael Caine , Seth Green and Verne Troyer with cameos from Tom Cruise , Danny DeVito , Gwyneth Paltrow , Steven Spielberg , Quincy Jones , John Travolta , Britney Spears and more.

Myers first hinted at a follow-up in 2024, telling Entertainment Tonight that Austin “absolutely” has more story ahead.
The Canadian star then appeared in June on a FIFA World Cup livestream watch party with his son Spike , 14, and Trevor Noah . Asked whether audiences will see an Austin Powers 4 , Myers immediately responded, “Yes.”
After Myers appeared this year in the Michael Jackson biopic Michael , he will reprise his titular voice role in the animated Shrek franchise’s fifth installment .
